method: PubMed E-utilities esummary (title, first author, DOI) and efetch (abstract); PMC efetch full text where a PMC id exists. An evidence sentence counts as found when its words, lower-cased with punctuation removed, occur as one run in the abstract or the full text; evidence that joins several passages is checked passage by passage. The first pass checked all 48 PubMed-sourced rows of the first version (c75a8e757). The second pass checked only the 18 rows the second version (9a495c763) added or changed; the literature review was not repeated.
not_checked: The 5 Wiktionary rows unchanged since the first version; the lexicon records their check of 2026-11-09.
limit: A found sentence shows the source contains it. It does not show that patients in a family's population use the expression. Many sentences are authors' descriptions, several in case reports, reviews or clinical studies of another population. Source fit is recorded separately, as concerns of kind source_fit.
